name: Second-click stale-context on tiered/attribute line
expected: A tiered/attribute-priced line prices correctly on the FIRST reprice after a Unit Quantity (Unit Volume) attribute change - no one-cycle stale-context lag, no second 'Update Price' click. SC-3390 fix (IsPriceImpacting=true on the 26 tiered Unit-Volume PADs + Sync) keeps the attribute edit in the same reprice cycle.
actual: FIX VERIFIED INTACT + ENGINE SINGLE-PASS CORRECT, but the actual two-click SYMPTOM is not headless-reproducible. (1) All 26/26 tiered Unit-Volume PADs (AttributeDefinition 0tjWC0000000tqvYAA / Attribute_Volume) carry IsPriceImpacting=true today - the exact SC-3390 fix; 0 AttributeAdjustmentCondition rows on the attr = safe no-match pass-through as designed. (2) Single Force-reprice of the live UI-priced gold-oracle quote 0Q0WC000002gBPJ0A2 (CLSAAS line 0QLWC00000311rZ4AQ, committed Unit Volume=50, Feature Options=Managed Service, USD, list 2180) returned isSuccess=true/errorResponse=[] and the line priced NetUnitPrice=Base_Price__c=TotalPrice=1357.2 = correct tier 50-99 in ONE pass (CompletedWithPricing). The live prehook AttributeVolumePricingPrehook (01pWC000001wAzJYAU, mod 2026-06-26) is the post-fix two-pass Attribute_Tier_Pricing_Storage__c lookup. (3) The defect symptom is a UI side-panel-save-vs-reprice-hydrate timing race: it requires CHANGING the volume in the Product Configurator side panel and clicking 'Update Price', which cannot be staged via REST; a headless commit-then-reprice always reads the already-committed value (which prices correctly). 0 tiered lines org-wide carry a headless-stageable committed Unit Volume to even attempt the race.
evidence: Gold-oracle quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000002gBPJ0A2/view (line 0QLWC00000311rZ4AQ: Unit Volume=50 -> NetUnitPrice 1357.2 single pass, CompletedWithPricing); place resp scratchpad k12_place_resp.json (isSuccess=true, errorResponse=[]); PADs: SELECT IsPriceImpacting FROM ProductAttributeDefinition WHERE AttributeDefinitionId='0tjWC0000000tqvYAA' -> 26/26 true; AttributeAdjustmentCondition on attr = 0; prehook ApexClass 01pWC000001wAzJYAU live; QLIA/OIA committed Unit Volume org-wide = 0.
notes: Active proc = Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 (design 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY, context SalesTransactionContextExt_v2 v23), confirmed Active 2026-06-29. The K-12 symptom is the SC-3390 two-click stale-context lag, which the authoritative RCA (project_sc3390_tiered_price_twice) proved is a UI commit/refresh ordering artifact - the engine prices its COMMITTED input perfectly (refuted as cause); the first click prices the STALE pre-edit committed value. Per that RCA the decisive 2-click proof is UI-only and CANNOT be reproduced headlessly (no REST path to race side-panel-save vs reprice; 0 tiered lines carry a headless-stageable committed Unit Volume). SC-3390 fix (a) shipped+validated in UAT 2026-06-11 = IsPriceImpacting false->true on the 26 tiered Unit-Volume PADs + Sync Pricing Data; I confirmed all 26 are still true today (fix intact, no Gearset/refresh revert) and the tiered engine single-pass prices the committed volume to the correct tier (1357.2 for vol 50). Relevant V21 steps: 13-24 Attribute Value Pricing modes (Calculated/Total Price/Unit Price + Base/Net bridges), 113 Sync InputUnitPrice for Discount Base, 114 Sync InputUnitPrice from Net; gate Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c (eligibility). VERDICT=BLOCKED (symptom not headless-testable), NOT a defect: the engine/config half PASSES and the documented fix is verified present. DURABILITY caveat (from SC-3390): IsPriceImpacting is pure PAD data, not deployable metadata - a Gearset/refresh PAD migration could silently revert the 26 flags->false and re-open the bug; re-verify the 26/26 after any refresh. Residual UI risk: prehook's null/no-tier-match silent reset-to-list still possible on a genuinely blank/Console Unit Volume. VALIDATION ONLY - no DML fixture created (reused existing live UI-priced gold-oracle quote as positive control); REST Force-reprice only; no deploys/proc/flow/Apex/metadata edits.
verdict_reason: The SC-3390 two-click stale-context symptom is a documented UI side-panel-save-vs-reprice timing artifact that is not headless-reproducible (no REST path to stage the volume-change race; 0 tiered lines carry a stageable committed Unit Volume), so the specific symptom cannot be smoke-tested = BLOCKED; the headless-testable engine/config half PASSES (26/26 tiered PADs IsPriceImpacting=true, single Force-reprice prices committed Unit Volume 50 to correct tier 1357.2 in one pass) and the SC-3390 fix is verified intact, so there is no reportable defect.
